title: Mexican Frittata
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired breakfast dish made with eggs and various vegetables.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the diced bell peppers and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked peppers and garlic in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Return to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Slide the frittata onto a plate and serve hot.
